احترمن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَرَمْنَ (iḥtaramna) /iħ.ta.ram.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
# اُحْتُرِمْنَ (uḥturimna) /uħ.tu.rim.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
# اِحْتَرِمْنَ (iḥtarimna) /iħ.ta.rim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
